notice.en: Public planning template, not a COA, TDS, certificate, approved specification or manufacturing commitment. Fill only nonconfidential requirements; unknowns may be “to discuss”. Keep confidential formulas out of public forms. Documents, supply, executors, costs and schedule require written confirmation.
notice.zh: 公开规划模板，并非 COA、TDS、证书、已批准规格或制造承诺。仅填写非保密需求，未知项可写“待讨论”。请勿通过公开表单发送保密配方。文件、供货、执行方、费用与排期须书面确认。

title.en: Ingredient sourcing brief & supplier document review
title.zh: 原料采购简报与供应商文件审核

fields.en: Company / contact / email; project reference and date
fields.zh: 公司／联系人／邮箱；项目编号及日期

fields.en: Ingredient / botanical identity / plant part; proposed SKU if known
fields.zh: 原料／植物身份／部位；已知拟购 SKU

fields.en: Target marker, method and limits requested; solvent / carrier / origin requirements
fields.zh: 拟要求的标志物、方法及限值；溶剂／载体／产地要求

fields.en: Application, target countries, intended use level; pH / heat process / packaging
fields.zh: 应用、目标国家、拟添加量；pH／热处理／包装

fields.en: Sample quantity and acceptance criteria; first order / annual estimate with units
fields.zh: 样品数量及验收标准；首单／年用量估计及单位

fields.en: Destination, desired date, budget currency; packaging / Incoterms to discuss
fields.zh: 目的地、期望日期、预算币种；待议包装／贸易术语

title.en: Supplier document review — record evidence, not assumptions
title.zh: 供应商文件审核——记录证据，不作推断

fields.en: For each requested file record: document name / SKU or lot / version-date / issuer / received date / reviewer / gap / next action
fields.zh: 每份所需文件记录：名称／SKU或批次／版本日期／出具方／收到日期／审核人／缺口／下一步

fields.en: TDS: match identity, composition, methods, limits, storage and shelf-life basis to offered SKU
fields.zh: TDS：核对拟供SKU的身份、组成、方法、限值、储存及保质期依据

fields.en: Genuine lot COA: match lot and specification; review actual results, units, methods and applicable contaminant limits. A sample COA does not release a future lot
fields.zh: 真实批次COA：匹配批次及规格；审核实际结果、单位、方法和适用污染物限值。样例COA不代表后续批次放行

fields.en: Certification if required: holder, legal entity, site, scope, issuer, number, validity and verification source. A logo is not evidence
fields.zh: 如需认证：持有人、法人、场地、范围、机构、编号、有效期及核实来源。标识不是证据

fields.en: Traceability / allergen / residual-solvent / import documents: list applicable requests and missing items
fields.zh: 追溯／过敏原／溶剂残留／进口文件：列出适用请求及缺失项

fields.en: Disposition: pending evidence / clarify / acceptable for stated review scope / not acceptable; reviewer and date. Do not equate document review with shipment release
fields.zh: 结论：待证据／需澄清／在注明审核范围内可接受／不可接受；审核人及日期。文件审核不等于货物放行

fields.en: Confirm source (own / partner / custom), availability, sample fees/freight, MOQ, lead time, quote validity, payment and responsible contact before ordering
fields.zh: 下单前确认来源（自产／合作／定制）、可用性、样品费用及运费、MOQ、交期、报价有效期、付款及负责人

title.zh: 概念阶段 ODM 项目简报

fields.en: Company / contact / email; project reference and date
fields.zh: 公司／联系人／邮箱；项目编号及日期

fields.en: Target audience, occasion and target countries; intended product category
fields.zh: 受众、使用场景及目标国家；拟定产品类别

fields.en: Beverage format, flavor and sweetness preferences; reference concept (not a validated formula)
fields.zh: 饮料形式、口味与甜度偏好；参考概念（不是已验证配方）

fields.en: Candidate ingredients / exclusions / allergens; claims needing local review (not approved claims)
fields.zh: 候选原料／排除项／过敏原；需当地审核的宣称（非已获准宣称）

fields.en: Packaging direction, desired shelf life and storage conditions to validate
fields.zh: 包装方向、待验证的期望保质期及储存条件

fields.en: Budget currency / range, initial quantity with units and desired timing; unknowns to discuss
fields.zh: 预算币种／范围、首批数量及单位、期望时间；未知项待议

title.en: Proposed stage gates — agree before execution
title.zh: 拟定阶段门槛——执行前约定

fields.en: Brief review: customer approves scope, unknowns and candidate-material document requests
fields.zh: 需求审核：客户确认范围、未知项及候选原料文件请求

fields.en: Prototype: name R&D executor; agree fees, iterations, sensory criteria and safety/market review before work
fields.zh: 打样：确定研发执行方；开工前约定费用、迭代次数、感官标准及安全／市场审核

fields.en: Validation: name testing executor; agree protocol, packaging, stability criteria, records and stop/go decision owner
fields.zh: 验证：确定检测执行方；约定方案、包装、稳定性标准、记录及停止／继续决策人

fields.en: Production feasibility: confirm qualified partner/site/line, pilot criteria, IP, release responsibility, costs and delivery scope in writing
fields.zh: 生产可行性：书面确认合格合作方／场地／产线、中试标准、知识产权、放行责任、费用及交付范围

fields.en: Next action / owner / due date / evidence needed; no project is accepted by completing this template
fields.zh: 下一步／负责人／期限／所需证据；填写本模板不代表项目已获承接

title.zh: 成熟配方转移审核清单

fields.en: Company / contact / email; project reference and date
fields.zh: 公司／联系人／邮箱；项目编号及日期

fields.en: Nonconfidential format, target countries, packaging, process stage and completed trials
fields.zh: 非保密的剂型、目标国家、包装、工艺阶段及已完成试验

fields.en: Formula ownership or authorization status; NDA contact and approved secure handover method to agree before sharing
fields.zh: 配方权属或授权状态；分享前约定保密协议联系人及获准的安全交接方式

fields.en: Initial volume with units, schedule and budget currency; known transfer constraints
fields.zh: 首批数量及单位、排期和预算币种；已知转移约束

title.en: Controlled technical handover — inventory only, no formula here
title.zh: 受控技术交接——仅列资料目录，不在此填写配方

fields.en: Record owner / version / availability / gap for formula and BOM, raw-material specifications, process flow and critical parameters
fields.zh: 记录配方与BOM、原料规格、工艺流程及关键参数的负责人／版本／可用性／缺口

fields.en: Inventory trial reports, analytical methods, packaging specifications and stability evidence; agree secure access after confidentiality approval
fields.zh: 列出现有试验报告、分析方法、包装规格及稳定性证据；保密获批后约定安全访问

fields.en: Compare proposed executor/site/line capability with process and packaging needs; document gaps rather than assume compatibility
fields.zh: 将拟执行方／场地／产线能力与工艺及包装要求比对；记录差距，不假定适配

fields.en: Agree pilot plan, change control, deviations, acceptance/rejection criteria and stop/go owner
fields.zh: 约定中试方案、变更控制、偏差处理、接受／拒绝标准及停止／继续决策人

fields.en: Assign market/label review, testing, batch release, traceability, IP and retained-record responsibilities
fields.zh: 分配市场／标签审核、检测、批次放行、追溯、知识产权及记录保存责任

fields.en: Written feasibility outcome: pending evidence / pilot review / not feasible; named executor, quote, MOQ and schedule remain to confirm
fields.zh: 书面可行性结论：待证据／中试审核／不可行；具体执行方、报价、MOQ及排期仍须确认
